segments.text: Yuuki's father and Yuriko's husband. He is also Saya's older brother.
He works for major general trading company and spends most of the year on business trips. He is currently on assignment in Europe.
He is a sports-orientated, as is typical of a successful trading company man, and is very strict when it comes to education.

He comes into conflict with Shouko regarding Yuuki who wants to raise him in a carefree manner. This reached its climax when Yuuki drew an illustration of him instead of studying and ended up divorcing Shouko.
He reflected on his actions during the situation and feels guilty about it. He eased up on his criticisms about her.
He remarried Yuriko who was a kouhai from the same company, but he continues to make frequent business trips.

The protagonist of this story and Shouko's only son. He has a calm and easygoing personality, like his mother, and does not take things too seriously. Therefore, he does not feel lonely even when his father is away, and spends his days peacefully.

His academic performance is middle of the class. He also plays sports as well as anyone else, but he is not outstanding in anything. His hobby is drawing illustrations, and he is quite good at it. In the future, he would like to become a illustrator.
When he visits illustration-related websites, he often sees erotic pictures because he is quite interested in sex. He also has a very big dick.

Yuki's biological mother and Naoki's ex-wife. Yuki calls her "mama". She has a laid-back and calm personality but holds strong convictions.
She used to work as a receptionist at Naoki's company and is a very beautiful and stylish woman.

She became a little overweight because she was a housewife after her marriage. She has a plump body and big breasts. After her divorce from Naoki, she moved to a nearby apartment and works part-time as an office worker.
She is good friends with Naoki's sister (Saya) and his new wife (Yuriko) and sees them frequently.
She run's "yuuki-kun's mama club" and keeps it under wraps.

Naoki's younger sister who lives nearby. Yuki calls her "saya-mama" and adores her. She has a cheerful and open personality. She is a career woman who competes with thousands of writers from all over the world. She is an editor for a magazine.
She has a slender build with slightly small breasts. Instead, her butt is quite large. She has been in relationships but never got married. She is currently single.
